status: Prospective browser acceptance protocol. Native implementation may already be underway; this is not native preregistration.
beneficiary: The existing FieldJourney and its same confirmed person after actual final Crossing completion.
source: north-star/prototype/return_gate.gd and tests/gate_checks.gd preserve arrival gating, two separate interrupted tasks, surviving mechanism, optional shutdown and explicit exit. New discrete turns, threat/cost magnitudes and no-retry policy are original destination design, not timing-equivalent Godot execution.
question: Can a privately owned portable post-Crossing objective require consequential paid work and actual exit while preserving the complete historical child and transferred resources?
hypothesis: The same person can explicitly enter and complete a finite two-catch objective after real final arrival, with actual costs, failure and alternative direct/grounding policies, without modifying historical Crossing results or manufacturing return/delivery.
rivals: Apparent success could be caused by invented healing, restored resolve, grants, weakened threats or duplicate rewards.
Two catches or disabled threat could be mislabeled as completed exit.
New HP could silently compete with an active child owner or rewrite the completed Crossing history.
A truthful JSON result could have a false visible completion or current-versus-historical HP picture.
Scripted policy success could be misrepresented as human agency, balance, preference or a faithful Godot port.

contract.entry: Explicit only after actual final Complete, confirmed identity and positive remaining HP; no survey/loss/withdrawal label or client fields can authorize it.
contract.ownership: Gate owns current health/resolve only after a one-time transfer from inactive completed child. All prior child mutations refuse after entry; intake/memory/fittings/sample history remain exact.
contract.work: Two separate paid tasks require their declared uninterrupted action sequence. Moving/release/contact damage interrupts partial work. Fatal or broken mechanism takes precedence over apparent work/exit completion.
contract.shutdown: Optional grounding spends actual finite mechanism integrity and may suppress later threat; it supplies neither catches nor exit completion.
contract.terminal: Explicit actual surviving exit owns gate completion. Gate outcome and historical Crossing Complete remain separate. No home arrival, sample delivery, sale, XP, healing, refunded rig or checkpoint reset follows.
contract.observations: GET, wall time, redraw, hidden-road keyboard, stale/forged/refused input cannot advance paid gate state. Late receipt recovery remains explicit and cannot replay a command.

acceptance: Complete the real visible Field route and compare exact transferred HP/resolve/identity to the completed child before any gate action.
Reject gate entry before confirmation, during survey and after withdrawal; reject forged fields through the actual HTTP adapter.
Execute declared direct and grounded policies in separate actual complete Field journeys before claiming two viable policies; retain all accepted commands and actual differing costs.
Prove one paid partial work is interrupted by a real alternative action and by actual damage where the declared policy exposes it.
Two raised catches and grounding alone remain incomplete; only actual surviving exit completes.
Retain an actual wait-only losing policy with no retries or restored resources.
Compare exact frozen child/history JSON across every accepted/refused gate transition; preserve earned XP, consumed rigs and sample history.
Repeated GET, elapsed wall time, redraw/navigation and stale requests preserve gate facts and send no paid transition.
Actual current gate HP and historical child HP, same person, phase, catches, resources and terminal pictures match the owner's observed state.
An isolated actual false-open/completion renderer must fail the same visible-state oracle; preserve producer and mutant bytes.
Replay accepted deterministic commands into a fresh native owner and require exact supported state equality.
Hash complete relevant source/protocol/producer/compiled-host inputs before and after execution; reject or explicitly supersede any changed-source run.
Reexecute affected maximal Field, focused-view, keyboard and withdrawal instruments when their closure or existing mutation-button contracts change.
analysis: This finite deterministic software study compares actual transitions and frozen histories. Multiple controls, sessions, policies, screenshots and replays are overlapping observations, not independent people, population estimates or measured effort. Failure and unsupported cases remain visible.
limits: No fresh source Godot execution is established by source inspection alone.
No original RGSS/RMXP execution, full battle system, account/save migration, recipient package or new laboratory.
No human usability, accessibility, gameplay balance, artistic approval, physical-device, Unity Editor/API/IL2CPP, Windows Player or Steam acceptance.
No certified actual home return or sample delivery merely from opening a passage.

brain_contribution.SCI-013: Rival hypotheses distinguish actual paid continuation from fabricated resource restoration or outcome labels.
brain_contribution.SCI-014: Actual JSON/PCM-free presentation controls operationalize software ownership, not human agency or enjoyment.
brain_contribution.SCI-017: Exact child-state and deterministic replay controls separate new gate decisions from altered old rules.
brain_contribution.SCI-061: Human/device/accessibility claims require appropriate participants and settings, absent here.

declared_destination_parameters.entry: Actual completed child HP/resolve, setup mechanism integrity3; no healing, retry or XP.
declared_destination_parameters.threat: Next paid beat cycles player2,quiet,winch1,quiet, unless grounded.
declared_destination_parameters.catch: Two consecutive work actions at its exact station; player damage/movement/release resets partial work. Winch damage does not itself cancel catch work.
declared_destination_parameters.brace: One resolve suppresses current beat threat and interrupts work.
declared_destination_parameters.ground: One action at ground costs2resolve+1integrity; pay before actual threat, then ground only if alive and integrity positive. This intentionally does not reproduce source1.5second interruptible grounding.
declared_destination_parameters.exit: Both catches required, actual move to exit then explicit exit; resolve threat and loss before completion.
